pr_title: Add support for displaying "unranked PP" placeholder
pr_body:
- [x] Depends on localisation for tooltip (needs `osu-resources` crowdin bump, cc @peppy)
- Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/27027

Not 100% sure about naming the "ranked" bool property as `Ranked` in `ScoreInfo`, but I'm not well aware about its intended usages, so I might be wrong if I said it's specifically for displaying "unranked PP" tooltip.

Also I've changed the icon of the "unprocessed PP" placeholder in line with https://github.com/ppy/osu-web/pull/10918/commits/5dd3db3be8cb7c05a0bef2d10c2bad4000fd4679.

issue_context.title: Scores with unranked mods still show as calculating in-game
issue_context.body:
need to fix the in-game overlay to match the updated web logic (see https://github.com/ppy/osu-web/pull/10918) ### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/27026
Originally posted by **Flamiii** February 4, 2024 The display on the website for scores with unranked mods recently changed. ![image](https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/74088315/f43812ad-b6ef-47c0-9474-0dd1fbd315cc) However, when looking at this score in the in-game webview, it still says that it is calculating when it isn't. ![image](https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/74088315/dc81a946-40a7-43e6-a1cb-755ae5cfcf08)

review_comments: Is there a reason this can't just be grouped in with the `UnrankedPerformanePointsPlaceholder` below? It seems like basically the same case.
Well if we're being strict then t's not the same case. This handles stuff like scores on loved/graved beatmaps. Web uses a different tooltip for those ("Only ranked beatmaps award pp").
The duplication of the symbol looks really awful, I'll alter the code slightly.
Might as well if it looks weird to someone already.

> Well if we're being strict then t's not the same case. This handles stuff like scores on loved/graved beatmaps. Web uses a different tooltip for those ("Only ranked beatmaps award pp").

From that angle can we already draw from web localisations for this case right in this PR to match?
I had done that already in the commit I pushed below.

Again, if we're being pedantic, then not quite because of https://github.com/ppy/osu-web/blob/64d540df6e8296e5090a9cc56a59189058585b67/resources/js/profile-page/play-detail.tsx#L126-L128

tl;dr loved maps should show a fontawesome heart instead of a dash.
